newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ALBANIA, Nov 18 - Durres - Seven vessels operating (all discharging) of which 1 fish meal, 1 bagged cement, 1 bricks, 2 bulk wheat, 1 bagged wheat flour, 1 bulk cement. 5 Vessels in roads awaiting berths of which 4 to discharge (1 potatoes, 1 wheat flour, 1 bulk cement, 1 bagged cement), 1 to load chrome ore.

BULGARIA, Nov 11-17 - Bourgas - 53 Vessels in port of which 32 loading (1 tobacco, 5 ammonium nitrate, 4 metals, 1 copper, 1 containers, 1 sunseed, 1 ammonium sulphate, 1 clinker, 4 steel, 1 general, 1 sugar, 4 benzene, 1 gasoil, 2 chemicals, 1 toluene, 2 fishmeal, 1 other). 12 Discharging (2 sugar, 3 fishmeal, 1 paper, 1 iron 1 wheat, 1 ferrosilicon, 3 petrol). 8 Discharging/loading (1 containers/ammonium nitrate, 2 salt/ general cargo, 2 cars, 2 containers, 1 tobacco/paper), 1 not nominated. 14 vessels in roads, 8 to load (ammonium sulphate, ammonium nitrate, lead, containers, general cargo, benzene, crude, coils). 2 To discharge (cars, coal). 1 To discharge/load zinc concentrate/copper, 1 awaiting orders, 2 cargo not nominated. 20 Due of which 12 to load (1 iron ore, 3 general cargo, 3 steel, 2 zinc, 1 benzene, 1 bentonite, 1 copper). 7 To discharge (2 sugar, 1 coal, 4 iron ore). 1 To discharge/load containers/ammonium nitrate.

Varna East, Varna West, Balchik, Teps - 37 Vessels operating of which 19 loading (4 fertiliser, 1 magnetite, 1 glass, 1 cement, 1 kaolin, 1 cellulose, 4 soda, 2 sas, 1 wood products, 1 scrap, 1 clinker, 1 ntp). 9 Discharging (5 coal, 3 phosphorite, 1 rice). 7 Discharging/loading containers, 2 trucks/containers. 9 In roads, 2 to load (clinker, soda), 3 to discharge (1 rice, 2 coal), 2 to discharge/load containers, 2 not nominated. Nov 18 - Varna East - 4 Vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging, 1 waiting to discharge, 1 bunkering, 3 awaiting orders. Varna West - 8 Loading at berth, 2 discharging, 2 waiting to discharge, 2 bunkering. Varna Lesport/tanker port - No vessels. Bourgas East - 8 Loading at berth, 1 discharging, 13 waiting to load, 1 to discharge, 7 under repairs/dry-docked, 20 due. Bourgas West - 5 Loading at berth. Bourgas tanker port - 2 Loading, 1 discharging.

CROATIA, Nov 18 - Rijeka - Two vessels discharging at berth, 8 loading, 6 under repair/dry-docked, 2 at inoperative berth, 2 anchored. Delays expected. Zadar - Two discharging, 1 due, delays expected. Ploce - One discharging at berth. Pula, Rasa, Sibenik, Split, Dubrovnik - No vessels.

CYPRUS, Nov 19 - Limassol - Two container vessels discharging/loading at berth, 1 conventional discharging, 2 ro/ros discharging/loading at berth. 3 Waiting at anchor to discharge/load. 11 due 20/11 of which 4 containers, 2 conventional, 4 passenger, 1 cruise. Larnaca - One container loading/discharging at berth, 2 conventional discharging at berth. 2 Due 20/11 of which 1 containers, 1 conventional.

ESTONIA, Nov 19 - No labour problems. Tallinn city port - 3 Vessels loading at berth (1 ferro-alloy, 2 map), 1 liner, 6 due. Kopli - 2 Sawn timber vessels loading at berth, 1 flour vessel discharging, 4 due. Muuga - 2 Loading at berth (1 oil, 1 timber), 4 discharging (3 grain, 1 bricks), 3 ferries, 1 due. Parnu - Six loading at berth (2 timber, 1 peat, 3 briquettes), 6 due.

ITALY, Nov 19 - Naples, Salerno, Gaeta - No vessels in roads. Genoa - Commercial port - 1 Vessel in roads, no delays. 29 Vessels berthed, 4 dry-docked. Multedo - Oil harbour - 1 Vessel in roads, no delays. 3 Vessels berthed. Savona, Leghorn, Civitavecchia, Gaeta, Naples, Salerno, Palermo, Sarroch, Ancona/Falconara - No vessels in road, no delays. Vado Ligure - One vessel in roads, no delays. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays. 3 Vessels berthed, 6 under repair/dry-docked. Augusta - Oil harbour - No vessels in roads, no delays. 3 Vessels berthed. Syracuse - Oil harbour - No vessels in roads. Taranto - Seven vessels in roads, no delays. Ravenna - Five vessels in roads, no delays. Venice - Six vessels in roads. Trieste - One vessel in roads.

LATVIA, Nov 19 - No strikes in any port. Riga - Sixteen vessels in port of which 15 operating as follows, 5 timber loaders, 2 container loaders, 1 cotton loader, 2 fertiliser loaders, 1 tanker loader, 1 metal loader, 3 frozen food dischargers. 1 Vessel waiting, no delays, 17 vessels due. Ventspils - Nine vessels in port of which 7 operating as follows, 1 steel billets loader, 1 steel loader, 1 steel/steel billets loader, 1 cotton loader, 1 mop loader, 1 zinc loader, 1 pig-iron loader. 2 Vessels waiting, no delays, 13 vessels due. Liepaja - Four vessels in port, all operating, no vessels waiting, no delays. 3 Vessels due.

LITHUANIA, Nov 18 - Klaipeda - 22 Vessels operating of which 12 loading (1 oil, 3 fertiliser, 1 rape seed, 2 steel coils, 1 metal, 1 cement, 1 sun flowers, 1 containers, 1 pig iron). 9 Discharging (6 fish, 1 sugar, 1 dolomite/limestone, 1 coke). 1 Loading/discharging. 3 Vessels in roads, 30 due.

POLAND, Nov 19 - Szczecin - Sixty-three vessels loading at berth, 44 discharging at berth. 1 Vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 5 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 9 under repair/dry-docked. 1 Awaiting orders, 112 due. Gdynia - Thirteen vessels operating of which 6 loading at berth (2 coal, 2 bulk, 2 general cargo). 7 discharging at berth (5 general cargo, 2 grain). 5 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 22 due. Gdansk - Eleven vessels operating of which 8 loading at berth (3 coal, 2 general cargo, 3 bulkers). 3 discharging at berth (1 general cargo, 2 tankers). 4 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 14 due.

PORTUGAL, Nov 18 - Sines - Two vessels in port operating of which 1 discharging crude oil, 1 coal. 1 Vessel waiting to load gasoil/jet fuel. 7 Vessels due of which 3 to load (1 propane/butane, 1 propylene, 1 metallic structures). 4 To discharge (1 metallic structures, 1 a reactor, 2 coal). Leixoes - Ten vessels operating of which 6 general cargo, 4 container vessels. No vessels waiting, 10 piers vacant of which 8 with cranes and 2 without cranes.

ROMANIA, Nov 19 - Constantza - Forty-five vessels operating of which 21 general cargo (19 loading, 2 discharging), 10 bulkers (6 loading, 4 discharging), 6 bagged chemicals (all loading), 4 tankers (3 loading, 1 discharging), 1 container discharger. 7 Vessels waiting in roads, all to load, of which 1 general cargo, 4 bulkers, 1 bagged cement, 1 tanker. Constantza south (Agigea) - 2 General cargo vessels loading, 3 bulkers discharging. Mangalia - One bulker loading. Midia - Four livestock carriers loading.

RUSSIA - BALTIC PORTS, Nov 19 - No strikes. Kaliningrad - Nine vessels in port of which 8 operating as follows, 2 aluminium loaders, 1 birch loader, 1 paper loader, 1 scrap metal loader, 1 fish discharger, 2 grain dischargers. 1 Vessel waiting, no delays, 2 vessels due. Vyborg - Five vessels in port, all operating. No vessels waiting, no delays, 5 due. St. Petersburg - Commercial port - 17 Vessels operating of which 12 loading (3 non-ferrous metals, 1 sugar, 2 containers, 3 fertiliser, 1 machinery, 2 coal). 5 Discharging (2 frozen meat, 2 bananas, 1 containers). 3 Vessels waiting, 5 due. FAR EAST, Nov 19 - No delays/strikes/congestion. Vladivostok - Eighteen vessels in port of which 9 loading (2 metal, 3 timber, 2 general cargo, 2 containers), 1 passenger vessel. 8 vessels waiting. Nakhodka - 17 vessels in port of which 11 loading (6 metal, 3 timber, 1 cotton, 1 wood-pulp), 6 waiting. Vostochny - Five vessels in port of which 4 loading (1 coal, 1 timber, 1 metal, 1 equipment), 1 waiting. Posyet - two Vessels in port loading metal. Zarubino (formerly Khasan) - One metal loader.

BLACK SEA, Nov 18 - Novorossiysk - Seven vessels in port operating of which 6 loading (1 slabs, 1 urea, 1 steel, 1 cars, 1 cellulose, 1 peas), 1 discharging cattle. 5 Vessels waiting in roads of which 1 to load flowers, 4 to discharge (1 rice, 1 mandarins, 1 luggage, 1 empty bottles). 30 Vessels due of which 20 to load (3 scrap, 9 steel, 2 copper cathodes, 1 copper, 1 pipes, 1 urea, 1 paper/steel, 1 molasses, 1 beetroot flour). 9 To discharge (2 sugar, 2 rice, 2 citrus, 2 luggage, 1 cars). 1 to discharge/load containers. Oil terminal, Nov 19 - 1 Vessel in port loading crude oil, 6 waiting in roads to load crude oil. 7 Vessels due to load of which 5 crude, 2 diesel oil.

NORTHERN BASIN, Nov 19 - Murmansk - Six vessels operating of which 1 alumina, 2 steel, 1 apatite, 1 cabotage, 1 iron ore pellets. 2 Loaders waiting of which 1 aluminium, 1 eel. 13 Vessels due during the week of which 8 loaders (6 apatite, 1 steels, 1 nkp). 5 Dischargers (1 alumina, 1 general cargo, 1 anode paste, 2 cabotage).

SLOVENIA, Nov 18 - Five vessels berthed of which 1 bulk carrier loading coal, 1 livestock vessel loading bulls, 2 container vessels loading/discharging, 1 reefer discharging fruit. 12 Vessels due over the next 2 days of which 3 containers (to load/discharge). 5 Vessels to discharge (2 bulk carriers with slag/alumina, 2 reefers with bananas, 1 tanker with gasoline). 4 Vessels to load (1 general cargo for cars, 3 general cargo for steel profiles/paper). No delays expected.

SPAIN, Nov 15 - Santander - Four vessels loading (1 cement, 2 phosphate, 1 cars). 13 Discharging (2 fertiliser, 3 cars, 1 china clay, 1 soya beans, 1 clay, 1 paper in reels, 2 petrol, 1 for repairs, 1 scrap). No vessels anchored, no delays expected. Nov 18 - Aviles - Five vessels in port of which 2 loading steel products, 2 discharging (1 alumina, 1 zinc concentrates), 1 under repair. Gijon - Six vessels in port of which 2 discharging (1 coal, 1 g.o.). 4 Loading (2 steel products, 1 sugar, 1 cement). Stevedores strike commenced 18/11, with stoppages during the odd hours. Bilbao - Seventeen vessels operating of which 4 loading, 10 discharging, 3 loading/discharging, no delays. November 19 - Cadiz - Eighteen vessels operating of which 4 ro/ros, 1 tobacco, 1 clay, 4 semolina, 1 wood, 2 ship building materials, 1 wheat, 1 citrus, 3 under repairs, no delays. Pasajes - Twenty vessels in port of which 17 discharging (9 scrap, 1 general cargo, 4 steel, 1 fertiliser, 1 coal, 1 magnetite). 3 Loading steel, no delays.

TURKEY, Nov 18 - Istanbul - Haydarpasa - 11 Vessels operating of which 4 containers, 6 dry cargo, 1 ro/ro, port congested. Galata - 11 Cargo/passenger vessels operating, port congested. Ambarli - 13 Vessels operating, no berthing delays. Iskenderun - One ammonium nitrate discharger. Sasa terminal, 1 MEG discharger. Sariseki terminal, 1 fertiliser discharger. Yazicilar terminal - 1 Scrap iron discharger. Ekinciler terminal, 1 scrap iron discharger, 1 vessel at anchorage. Isdemir terminal, 1 coal discharger. Mersin - Fourteen vessels operating of which 7 loading (2 cement, 1 general cargo, 2 citrus, 1 chrome, 1 oil). 3 Discharging (1 cloth, 1 sun flower oil, 1 soya oil). 4 Loading/discharging (2 containers, 1 citrus, 1 oil). 14 Vessels at anchorage. November 19 - Mersin - 22 vessels in port operating of which 9 loading (2 legumes, 1 general cargo, 1 cement, 1 chrome, 1 construction material, 1 vegetable oil, 1 citrus, 1 minerals). 6 Discharging (1 fabric, 1 sun flower oil, 1 soda, 1 glucose, 1 paper, 1 soya bean oil). 7 Loading/discharging (1 vehicles, 5 containers, 1 containers/citrus/cartoon books). Free zone piers, no vessels. Seka - One vessel discharging fertiliser.

UKRAINE, Nov 18 - Mariupol - 11 Vessels in port operating of which 10 loading (4 fertiliser, 3 steel, 1 mustard seed, 1 coal, 1 sunflowerseed), 1 discharging equipment. 24 Vessels waiting in roads, 14 to load (2 fertiliser, 1 slabs, 8 sunflowerseed, 2 steel, 1 mustard seed). 8 To discharge (6 steel plates, 1 ferrous metals, 1 citrus). 2 To discharge/load containers. 25 Due of which 19 to load (4 fertiliser, 7 coal, 3 sunflowerseed, 1 rebars, 1 equipment, 2 steel, 1 zinc). 2 To discharge (1 bauxite, 1 fluorspar). 4 To discharge/load containers. Odessa - Nine vessels loading of which 1 urea, 5 metals, 2 oil, 1 barley, 1 discharging citrus, 3 under repair, 1 waiting. 3 vessels in roads of which 1 passenger, 2 waiting. 16 Due of which 12 to load (7 metal, 3 sunflowerseed, 1 oil, 1 seed cake). 1 To discharge grain, 3 to discharge/load containers.

Mariupol - 12 Loading at berth (metal products, urea, grain, fertiliser, sunflowerseed, sulphur, mustard seed, coal) 2 discharging at berth (general cargo, pvc). 6 Waiting at anchorage to load (fertiliser, metal products, sunflowerseed, containers/oranges). 19 To discharge (sunflowerseed, containers, metal products, mustard seed, fertiliser, oranges). 8 Floating storehouses (fertiliser, sulphur). 24 Vessels due (urea, coal, general cargo, sulphur, sunflowerseed, metal products, ore). Kerch - One vessel loading metal products at berth, 4 under repair/dry-dock, 1 waiting at anchorage to load metal products, 2 ore vessels due. Berdyansk - Two vessels loading at berth, 1 metal products, 1 agriproducts. 4 Due of which 3 to load metals, 1 fertiliser. Nov 19 - Odessa - Steel cargo loaders, 2 vessels berthed, 8 due. Containers 3 due. Grain loaders 1 berthed, 3 due. Grain dischargers 1 due. Tankers loading 1 berthed, 2 anchored. General cargo 1 berthed, 1 due. Fertiliser 1 vessel berthed. Ilychevsk - Steel cargo loaders 9 berthed, 1 anchored. Tankers discharging, 2 berthed.
YUGOSLAVIA, Nov 19 - Bar - Five vessels berthed of which 2 discharging bananas, 1 discharging oil, 2 loading steel coils. Zelenika/Bijela - No vessels operating, 3 under repair. No delays.
